description:
Create a SKU. Types: consumable (a balance: coins, boosts), non_consumable (owned once: skins, cars), timed (expiry extended by durationSeconds × quantity: season pass), unlock (never sold; held while `rule` holds). No price = reward-only. Price in base units (`price`) or in dollars (`priceUsdMicros`, with optional per-unit `minPrice`/`maxPrice` bounds in base units), never both. `currency` is what the buyer pays in: 'token' (default; recommended with priceUsdMicros — a steady dollar price, paid in the creator's token), 'native' or 'usdc'. GET /api/v2/iap/config lists each chain's currencies. `grants` makes a bundle. `splits` pays up to 2 more wallets (3 on a launchpad token) a share of each sale. New SKUs are drafts unless status is 'active'. Store key scope: catalog:write.

Params: store_id, sku ({sku, type, name, currency?, price?, priceUsdMicros?, minPrice?, maxPrice?, grants?, splits?, durationSeconds?, rule?, maxSupply?, maxPerWallet?, maxAppSpend?, saleStartsAt?, saleEndsAt?, status?, metadata?, description?, imageUrl?, sortOrder?}), session_token?, idempotency_key?
Returns: {ok, idempotency_key, sku: Sku}
Errors: NO_CREDENTIALS, IAP_PLAN_REQUIRED, HTTP_400 (validation), HTTP_409 (sku key taken)

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency-Key for this write. Omit to generate one; reuse the returned idempotency_key to retry safely

session_token.description: Session token from authenticate. Optional when CHAINDADDY_API_KEY is set (or, for store-scoped tools, CHAINDADDY_IAP_KEY)

currency.description: What the buyer pays in. 'token' (the default, and the recommended choice): the store's own token, so every sale is demand for it; pair it with priceUsdMicros for a steady dollar price. 'native': the chain's coin (ETH, BNB, POL, SOL…). 'usdc': the chain's dollar stable (USDC; USDG on Robinhood Chain; not on Gnosis). The buyer pays the creator directly in every case. price/minPrice/maxPrice are base units of this currency; an update that changes it must set price or priceUsdMicros in the same patch (the bounds clear). Unlocks take no currency

durationSeconds.description: timed SKUs: seconds added per unit

grants.description: Bundle: buying grants these items instead of itself

maxAppSpend.description: Consumables only: lets Crown Apps on the token page spend this item for the wallet that holds it (the `iap-consume` app action, no server), at most this many per request. null (the default): no app can, only a store key with iap_consume. Leave it null for anything redeemed for a prize or off-platform value

maxPrice.description: With priceUsdMicros in 'token' or 'native': never charge more than this per unit, in base units (decimal string). Refused with 'usdc'

minPrice.description: With priceUsdMicros in 'token' or 'native': never charge less than this per unit, in base units (decimal string). Refused with 'usdc', where the price is exact

price.description: Price in base units of the SKU's currency (decimal string); null = not for sale

priceUsdMicros.description: Price in US micro-dollars per unit instead of `price` ($5 = 5000000). Recommended with currency 'token'. Each order converts it to an exact amount of the SKU's currency and locks it: at the token's or coin's live price (the mean of the last 2 minutes of 15-second readings, rounded up to 4 significant figures), or exactly with currency 'usdc'. Set price OR priceUsdMicros, not both

anyOf.description: Rule: {all:[…]}|{any:[…]}|{not:…}|{hold:{min, token?, chainId?}}|{owns:{sku, min?}}. `min` for hold is base units

splits.description: Revenue splits: each sale also pays these wallets bps (1/100 of a percent) of the creator's share, the price after any platform fee, straight from the buyer's one payment. At most 2 (3 on a launchpad token, which pays no fee: one payment carries 4 payees), together at most 9999 so the store payout keeps a part. Not the payout, the fee recipient or the checkout. null clears

name: iap_create_sku
title: Create a store item
